details: Brent crude prices surged to $111.16 a barrel on Monday, following renewed tensions in the Middle East. This includes a drone attack on a United Arab Emirates nuclear power plant and stalled peace talks between the United States and Iran. U.S. President Donald Trump warned Iran to "get moving, FAST" on a peace deal, which is contributing to inflation fears and prompting predictions of central bank rate hikes globally.
title: Oil Prices Climb as US-Iran Tensions Escalate in Middle East

details: Bitcoin's value dropped below $77,000, reaching $76,551 on Monday. This decline is largely attributed to escalating geopolitical tensions between the U.S. and Iran. President Trump's recent warnings to Tehran have fostered a "risk-off" sentiment among investors, leading to over $500 million in crypto market liquidations and highlighting the cryptocurrency market's sensitivity to global conflicts.
title: Bitcoin Falls Below $77K as US-Iran Tensions Trigger Liquidations

details: The U.S. Senate Banking Committee has voted 15-9 to advance the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act of 2025 to the full Senate. This significant legislation aims to establish a comprehensive regulatory framework for cryptocurrencies, seeking to clarify jurisdictional issues and potentially fostering greater institutional adoption. The bill's progression is seen as a positive step for the crypto industry, despite ongoing debates with the traditional banking sector.
title: US Senate Committee Advances Landmark Crypto Clarity Act

details: Following a summit between President Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping, the United States and China have agreed to establish new bilateral trade and investment boards. China has committed to purchasing at least $17 billion annually in U.S. agricultural products for the next three years and approved an initial order for 200 Boeing aircraft. This signals a potential de-escalation in ongoing trade tensions between the two global economic powers.
title: US and China Establish New Trade Boards, Announce Boeing, Agriculture Deals
